1.11.34: Fixed an issue where iTunes/Spotify fallback search logic would grab the release date of popular older songs (like 'In the End') when searching for a newer song (like 'Two Faced') by enforcing strict track name matching in addition to artist matching.
1.11.33: Fixed iTunes/Spotify fallback logic mistakenly prioritizing Kidz Bop or other cover songs that have older release dates by enforcing strict artist name matching.
